# NutriCoach

> NutriCoach is a personal nutrition coaching platform that helps you track meals, plan macros, build healthy habits, and reach your wellness goals.

NutriCoach combines precision macro tracking (BMR, TDEE, custom ratios), AI-assisted meal planning with a recipe vault, workout logging, progress tracking, and a community feed.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Your personal nutrition and wellness dashboard.
- [Sign In](/auth): Create an account or sign in to NutriCoach.
- [Forgot Password](/forgot-password): Recover access to your account.
